adaptations.purpose: Avoid scanning/loading every dynamic engine when a requested web engine is not found.
invariants: Emscripten dynamic builds load only the selected engine; non-web fallback behavior remains intact.
verification: Inspect cold and warm Brave network requests for at least two engines; no unrelated plugin downloads, including an unavailable target.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream web plugin lookup provides equivalent selective loading without a fallback scan.

adaptations.purpose: Make Lure popup actions click-selectable in the web build.
invariants: Web mouse/touch can select an explicit menu item; keep native touchscreen-dependent behavior elsewhere.
The current diff contains redundant nested EMSCRIPTEN guards. Preserve the behavior when porting, not that accidental nesting.
verification: In Brave, open a Lure popup with a mouse and touch controls; choose distinct actions and dismiss the popup.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream web popup interaction supports these inputs without the override.

adaptations.purpose: Prevent a trailing tap that dismisses speech from selecting a new Queen dialogue option.
invariants: A new dialogue list requires deliberate input after the 180 ms debounce; options remain reachable.
verification: In Brave Queen dialogue, dismiss a spoken line and confirm the newly drawn choices are not auto-selected; then select a choice normally.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream input handling consumes the trailing release/tap or implements equivalent deliberate selection.

adaptations.purpose: Recognize the supported 827397764-byte freeware data.b25c package.
invariants: Preserve unknown-language metadata so changing the game language does not break detection.
The existing series contains a size-only entry and a checksum entry (1f89a63e3509aa64626cc90cd2561032). Review collision/order behavior when porting; do not broaden detection further.
verification: Detect and launch the supported package, change language, and relaunch; check unrelated variants are not mislabeled.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream recognizes the exact supported package with suitable language handling; prefer its verified fingerprint over a redundant size-only fallback.

adaptations.purpose: Use the shell-mounted game/data/save filesystems through the POSIX backend.
invariants: Keep OSystem_POSIX initialization and access to /data, /games and existing BrowserFS saves.
Do not restore the upstream HTTP filesystem factory over the shell mounts.
verification: Run test/runtime-bootstrap.test.mjs and test/scummvm-filesystem.test.mjs; launch catalog and imported games and save/resume in Brave.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream initialization natively supports these mounted filesystems without replacement or incompatible operations.

adaptations.purpose: Avoid requesting access to physical MIDI devices during web startup.
invariants: No requestMIDIAccess permission prompt; midiOutputMap remains a valid empty Map for internal-driver fallback.
verification: Check a fresh Brave launch does not prompt for MIDI permissions; verify built-in music still works on a supported title.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream makes external MIDI access opt-in and preserves the same built-in music behavior.

adaptations.purpose: Recognize the supported English seven-CD combined DOS install.
invariants: Preserve the Combined DOS install entry: ressci.000 cd5967f9b9586e3380645961c0765be3/116822037 and resmap.000 9a479f0ab586359b424e35165dd7559e/16468.
Keep English DOS metadata and Phantasmagoria GUI options; do not conflate other language editions.
verification: Using an owned matching package, verify native detection, startup and access to combined-disc resources in Brave.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream has an equivalent combined-DOS detection entry and the matching package passes regression checks.

adaptations.purpose: Keep Titanic class registrations from becoming one expensive browser compilation unit.
invariants: The Emscripten registration helper stays out of line; class names, inheritance and factories remain identical.
verification: Measure Titanic launch in Brave and verify a scene plus save/load class reconstruction; compare startup compilation behavior.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream or the selected compiler bounds compilation cost while preserving the class registry and save compatibility.

adaptations.purpose: Initialize the Access engine language from the detected game description.
invariants: Use detected language rather than unknown-language initialization, preserving per-edition behavior.
verification: Launch an owned supported Access edition in Brave; confirm correct language/resource handling and no startup assertion.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream initializes the same language correctly and the edition passes the check.

adaptations.purpose: Allow Toltecs releases lacking both custom AdLib instrument tables to use built-in instruments.
invariants: Keep the Miles path when custom SAMPLE.AD or SAMPLE.OPL data is present.
If both tables are absent, show the sound-difference warning and keep music through the standard driver.
verification: Check an owned Toltecs release with absent tables: dismiss the warning and verify music; retain the custom-table path when available.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream provides the same missing-table fallback and honest user notice.

adaptations.purpose: Recognize spaced CD-ripper filenames while retaining conventional ScummVM names.
invariants: Preserve existing trackN, trackNN, track_N and track_NN candidates.
Spaced names use physical one-based track numbers; the playback API uses zero-based numbers. Preserve plain, zero-padded and space-padded spaced names.
verification: Verify first and later extracted CD tracks play correctly with both conventional and spaced naming; avoid an off-by-one track shift.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream candidate generation covers the same formats and numbering semantics.

adaptations.purpose: Report a real native game presentation to the browser shell instead of relying on WebGL brightness polling.
invariants: Announce __scummwebNativeFrames and call __scummwebOnGameFrame after refresh, with g_engine, no overlay, and splash completed or GUI already launched.
Only an accepted callback ends reporting; support intentionally dark frames and exclude splash/GUI setup draws.
Keep the change web-only and preserve the native splash/intro timing.
verification: Run first-frame, runtime-bootstrap and game-route-frame tests. In Brave, verify DreamWeb and another engine reach native readiness, preserve intro/skip, and compare warm launch timings; inspect the callback contract on an SDK change.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream exposes an equivalent reliable game-presentation lifecycle signal that ScummWEB consumes and verifies.

adaptations.purpose: Adapt generated SDL3 playback glue to clear output buffers and contain invalid samples.
invariants: Prime every output channel with silence before the mixer callback.
Handle non-finite samples, clamp to [-1,1], silence excessively abnormal buffers, and leave recording behavior untouched.
Exact-pattern replacement is idempotent and fails on unsupported generated glue rather than silently skipping the adaptation.
verification: Run test/scummvm-shell-output.test.mjs and test/audio-start-control.test.mjs; listen in Brave for startup/silence artifacts, sound playback and correct gesture handling.
adaptations.retire_when: The selected upstream SDL/Emscripten output path already provides equivalent initialization and sample containment, demonstrated by output tests and audible checks.

adaptations.purpose: Expose native save listing and startup loading to ScummWEB, including isolated personal imports.
invariants: Respect both native capability flags and PreAGI/Mohawk exclusions; never force unsupported startup loading.

List real nonempty files; exclude nonexistent autosave placeholders, Kyrandia restart saves and Groovie slot 0 reserved/Open House state. Resolve fixed prefixes for Lure, Queen, Tony, Cruise and Draci through the native filename API.
Choose the latest player save again before engine construction; retain the selected version savepath and actual detected target.
Query mode follows normal web plugin initialization and force-exits after save reporting, before engine creation; CLI listing is not a web query path.
verification: Run browser save and native bridge tests; rebuild the managed runtime.
In Brave verify Play with no player saves, supported catalog and imported save/resume, latest-write ordering, checkpoint exclusion, and unsupported engines retaining Play.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream exposes equivalent browser-callable save metadata and startup resume with the same eligibility and save isolation guarantees.

adaptations.purpose: Return hosted game sessions to ScummWEB before the native launcher can be constructed, and explicitly signal ordinary engine exits.
invariants: When __scummvmRequestExit is installed, launcherDialog signals the host and returns before creating any native launcher UI, for both initial fallback and return-to-launcher.
Successful main teardown explicitly signals the host; do not depend on Module.quit/onExit because the generated keepalive runtime can bypass both.

Keep non-web and bridge-free command-line tooling behavior; preserve native error dialogs, save cleanup, and same-origin host navigation. The shell hides the canvas synchronously and sends one exit notification regardless of prior input.
verification: Run test/game-exit.test.mjs and rebuild the managed runtime.
In Brave verify a game-native quit, ScummVM Return to Launcher, app Exit game, and a relaunch. The native launcher must never appear; verify Escape still works as ordinary game/menu input.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream provides a host-controlled single-session lifecycle that prevents native launcher presentation and reliably reports engine termination with runtime keepalive enabled.

adaptations.purpose: Publish browser save metadata after completed native output streams, including original engine save dialogs and autosaves.
invariants: Invalidate the cached filename before opening or truncating its output; refuse the write if invalidation cannot persist.
Finalize compression, close the underlying descriptor, then refresh native save listing outside FS.close; cover destructor-only saves and propagate finalization and BrowserFS close failures.
Track pending or failed filenames across reloads; failed or interrupted writes cannot become Continue candidates. Successful deletions refresh metadata. Keep non-web behavior unchanged.
verification: Run browser-saves, continue-saves, native-save-completion and hero-launch-actions tests; rebuild the managed runtime.
In Brave verify Lure original-menu saving and Sky manual/autosaves, immediate tab-close persistence, failed-write exclusion, restore conflicts and single-writer gameplay locking.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream provides equivalent browser save completion and failure callbacks after persistent stream closure, consumed with the same pending-write and validation guarantees.

adaptations.purpose: Provide opt-in read-only Queen room telemetry for an external benchmark evaluator.
invariants: No telemetry unless the evaluator enables it before launch; no gameplay mutation or MCP observation fields.
Report current room after display update; room_ready requires no pending room transition and no running cutaway.
Retain ordered room/ready transitions until consumed; overflow is explicit, never silently discard a possible endpoint.
verification: Run test/queen-evaluation.test.mjs; build the native Queen plugin.
Through AgentSCUMM, start a fresh Queen game and verify room 70 does not stop it, room 71 stops with success, and later inputs are not delivered.
adaptations.retire_when: Upstream supplies equivalent opt-in room/presentation telemetry with verified transition semantics.

adaptations.purpose: Replace stale native keyboard callbacks retained across SDL window recreation, preventing one browser press from producing multiple game characters.
invariants: Keep one registration per target, event type, native callback and capture phase; replace stale userData with the newest registration.
Preserve independent native callbacks, ordinary DOM listeners, separate targets, key releases, modifiers and genuine held-key repeat.
Apply idempotently on full builds and shell-only refreshes; fail on changed generated glue instead of skipping the adapter.
verification: Run test/keyboard-runtime.test.mjs and test/keyboard.test.mjs; regenerate the managed shell.
In Brave Mystery House, verify a single G, Return, typed commands and Backspace after display initialization; verify a native game menu shortcut.
adaptations.retire_when: The selected SDL/Emscripten combination reliably unregisters keyboard callbacks when recreating a window, with one callback per browser event verified after Mystery House startup and display changes.
